quests.desc: Welcome to another profound session of TextWorld! First thing I need you to do is to travel west. With that done, make an effort to venture west. With that done, attempt to go west. With that over with, venture south. With that over with, make an attempt to head east. Okay, and then, make an effort to travel east. And then, pick up the vacuum from the floor of the bathroom. Once that's all handled, you can stop!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, attempt to move west. And then, go to the west. With that over with, attempt to go to the west. Following that, head south. And then, try to venture east. With that accomplished, try to go to the east.
